summary_1line: Ravana assaults the apsara Rambha despite her pleas, prompting Nalakuvara to curse him that forced violation will shatter his head.

image_candidates.scene_text: Under the moonlit forests of Mount Kailasa, Ravana seizes the jeweled apsara Rambha as blossoms fall and celestial music drifts through the night.
Rambha, disheveled and trembling with torn garlands, collapses at Nalakuvara’s feet to report Ravana’s assault.
Nalakuvara, eyes blazing, lifts sacred water in his hand and pronounces a fiery curse as flowers rain from the heavens.
